NOT PROVED / PRECISE FIRST MISSING:
- S1890PseudofunctorCoherence is NOT proved and, as stated in S1890, is not a derivable proposition: it quantifies over ARBITRARY mapComp/mapId. What remains for S1864(a) is exactly S1935RemainingSitePseudofunctor f g, i.e. the concrete comparison data (from S1890RestrictCompIso / S1890RestrictIdIso) plus the three coherence equations for those data.
- Identity half: S1890IdSquare is now covered by SiteIdF (S1922), the C-side mapId naturality, and SiteIdG (proved here).
- Composite half: DIRECTION MISMATCH discovered: S1890CompSquare consumes beta_1.hom and beta_2.hom (hom-direction naturality of g.map), while S1890SiteCompG is stated in the beta/inverse direction. So before S1890CompSquare can be instantiated at the site one must also state/prove the hom-direction g-side pasting identity; S1890 does not state it. NOT DONE BY ME: coord/STATE.md, coord/queue.md, AUDIT_LEDGER.md and node bookkeeping were not updated (left to parent/integrator). S1890/S1922 files were not modified.`;
